row.title: Every tenant app lives in its own repository; Unlearn moves to ultrastable/unlearn
row.body: Rowan: a tenant app needs its own repo. Decision: a registry (doctrine/tenant-repos.json), a workflow that creates the repo from the tenant folder's history with vendored core files, and a core deploy route that builds a topology worker from its tenant repository's main (source.repo), redeployed daily when that main moves. A check fails new tenant code in the core. Deploys go through the core's OIDC deployer, so the tenant repository holds no credential and the deploy gateway's rules stay as they are.

title: Every tenant app lives in its own repository; Unlearn moves to ultrastable/unlearn
